lists.use: A criterion whose phase title and text hold one of these verbs gets the obligation kind `effect-witness`, else `positive` (lib/verification_plan.py:800).
The suite of a phase gets the discovered build command only when the title or the criteria of the phase hold one of these words (lib/verification_plan.py:879).
lists.wordBoundaryNote: The pattern keeps the baseline's \b on both sides, so `.d.ts` matches only after a word character (`index.d.ts`), never on its own. That is the baseline's behaviour and is kept.
